A '''circular saw'''<ref name="CFTD" /> or '''buzz saw'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a small, highspeed cutting tool. Constructed of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], circular saws were strong enough to cut through obstacles including power cables, thick foliage, and [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]]. Circular saws were common components installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]], either mounted externally onto their body, or installed in an internal compartment and deployed when needed. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] manufactured the [[Type 10 Cutting Saw]].<ref name="CFTD" />

[[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droids]], also called "buzz droids," were armed with circular saws that allowed them to cut through the [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] while in combat.<ref name="III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[P2-series astromech droid|P2]], [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]], and [[R5-series astromech droid]]s were also equipped with circular saws that assisted them with simple repair jobs.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] used his to escape from an [[Ewok]] trap during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Rebel mission to Endor]].<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
